_doc: Host bindings of an instance (shipped default: none). An instance overrides this file in config/router/host.json. Paths: absolute, ~/ or @instance/. log_dir: cycle logs; collect_script: leaderboard collection (empty = skipped); control_env: HMAC secret of the manual trigger; control_origin / library_domain: where the library page and its trigger are served (empty = not published).
